decision_reason: This assigned repository is the backend and database layer of Terminfinder, an appointment-polling service explicitly described by Dataport as made by Dataport and the State of Schleswig-Holstein. The live service runs on an official Schleswig-Holstein government domain; this repository exposes the backend, database, deployment configuration, and documentation under a repository-level EUPL-1.2 grant. The dated initial public GitHub source mirror includes the grant in 2022. This review is component-scoped; the frontend is a separate assigned URL and its grant is assessed independently. No catalog entry was added.

government_provenance.note: The Dataport-owned repository README calls Terminfinder a service made by Dataport and the State of Schleswig-Holstein, names Dataport AöR copyright, and describes the specific frontend/backend/database appointment-poll service. This is a direct authorship/offer claim, not merely government use of unrelated software.

public_source.note: The public repository exposes the ASP.NET backend source, database material, Docker/deployment configuration, and setup/configuration documentation without credentials.

eligible_license.note: The root LICENSE contains the full EUPL-1.2 grant; README expressly applies EUPL 1.2 to this backend repository. Scope here is the backend/database source in this repository, not the separately licensed frontend repository or third-party dependencies.

primary_evidence.note: The official Schleswig-Holstein domain serves the live Terminfinder SH application, links GitHub and OpenCoDE, and identifies the State Chancellery digitalisation contact. The repository documents production deployment and user-facing poll workflows, satisfying the operational government-service pathway.

decision_reason: DBeaver Community is a mature, actively distributed third-party database client, but its first-party history says it began as its founder’s hobby project, became open source in 2013, and was commercialized by DBeaver Corporation in 2017. The SILL page is a recommendation/catalog listing, not evidence of government creation, commissioning, funding, or stewardship. Reject on government provenance; no catalog entry was added.

government_provenance.note: DBeaver’s first-party history attributes the product to founder Serge Rider’s hobby project (2010), says its first open-source version was available in 2013, and says DBeaver Corp opened in 2017. No government authorship, commission, funding, or stewardship is evidenced; the French SILL entry is only a recommendation listing.

public_source.note: The public canonical repository exposes DBeaver Community source, release history, installation directions, and user documentation without credentials.

eligible_license.note: The root LICENSE.md contains the full Apache License 2.0 text. This finding is for the DBeaver Community Work covered by that repository grant; separately noticed files and third-party dependencies retain their own terms, and commercial Pro/Team products are not included in this grant.

primary_evidence.note: The official release page shows current DBeaver Community version 26.2.1 released 2026-09-21 with installable binaries; the repository links comprehensive user documentation and describes the supported database client.
